hero.subline: with our unique music production tool

intro.text: Build, arrange, and perform with MXGRID—a powerful music creation suite built for seamless beat-making and fluid loop sequencing. From raw samples to finished tracks, shape your sound with total precision.

features.heading: Live Performance at Your Fingertips
features.description: Play live using your mouse or MIDI controller. Express yourself in real-time performance.

features.heading: Ample Space for Creativity
features.description: With over 500 slots, organize your samples, loops and beats without limitations. Let your imagination run wild.

features.heading: Automated Sample Import
features.description: Streamline your workflow by automating the import process for media files. The software assigns tempo, color, icon, and instrument group to each sample.

features.heading: Plugin with 32 Outputs
features.description: Explore a world of effects and creative possibilities. With 32 outputs, you can route audio to various channels, apply effects, and achieve professional-grade soundscapes.

features.heading: Launchpad X and MIDI Device Support
features.description: MXbeats is Launchpad X-ready, providing native support for this popular MIDI controller and other compatible devices.

timeline.heading: Timeline Editor
timeline.description: Compose entire songs with built-in timeline editor. Arrange loops, beats and samples creating cohesive musical pieces.

demo.demoHeading: Unlock the Full Potential: Try Our Free Demo!
demo.demoDescription: No Strings Attached: Try our demo for free, as long as you like, with no obligations. You won't be asked for credit card details or any commitment.

meta.title: MXbeats — Music Production and Arrangement Software
meta.description: MXbeats is an evolving music production platform for performance, arrangement, and sound design.
